ambiguity_rule: strictly positive count-plus-mean-response advantage over first geometrically distinct runner-up; single hypothesis margin=2
m2: not executed by this entry point; separate authorization required
peak_threshold_rule: single shared strict threshold=max(0, all peak responses of correct-key plain/content_only/main_syncseal and one fixed external-wrong-key query on every image); no per-amplitude optimization
selection: smallest RMS passing all four sources: >=4 correct identities, accepted blind H, RGB control RMSE<=1, quality budgets and no loss of content-only pre>reference_tau
